structure: Negative controls around one genuine side pair: a guidance-only paragraph with no answer area; a Left knee / Right knee findings table (the only genuine answers); a consent declaration printed beside a legacy checkbox; a signature line; and an initials box cell.
authored_from: build_forms.py intent (f5_negative_controls), written before any engine run on this form
slot_grammar: neutral v3 ground-truth grammar; see check_expected.py

areas.label: Left knee
areas.cardinality: one free-text value (examination findings for the LEFT knee only)

destination.description: table 0, row 1, column 1 ('Examination findings' column, 'Left knee' row): blank cell

areas.label: Right knee
areas.cardinality: one free-text value (examination findings for the RIGHT knee only)

controls.printed: The reviewing clinician completes this page after discussing the findings with the patient. Record only what was examined at this visit.

destination.description: body paragraph b/p[1]: guidance only, no blank, no box

controls.reason: Guidance-only text has no answer area. Any field anchored here is a false field; writing into it would corrupt the instruction.

controls.printed: I confirm that the patient agreed to this examination and to these findings being shared with the referring team.

destination.description: body paragraph b/p[4]: a consent/attestation declaration with a legacy checkbox before it

controls.reason: A consent declaration is an attestation by the clinician. It is never ticked from a note or by a model: it must be absent from the answerable fields, or present only as a protected/signing area.
A signature is never generated. It must be absent from the answerable fields, or present only as a signature/protected area.

destination.description: table 1, row 0, column 1: the empty initials box beside the printed label

controls.reason: Initials are a signing act. Absent, or protected/initials kind only.

destination.description: the pair of findings cells b/tbl[0]/tr[1]/tc[1] and b/tbl[0]/tr[2]/tc[1]

controls.reason: Side collapse: any mapping that gives one field to both knees, drops the side from either label, or names the other side must be refused - a left-knee finding must never be able to reach the right-knee cell (the 'left knee pain accepted into a Right knee field' defect class).
A heading has no answer area.

extras_policy: Any other answerable field (header cells 'Joint' / 'Examination findings', spacer b/p[2], trailing b/p[6], the label cell 'Clinician initials') is a false field.
